scope: Proposal and static review only. This is not the V11 owner ledger, not a run of the frozen Python generator, and not a publication receipt.

checkpoint_contract.composition: The complete checkpoint consists of the unchanged full baseline file plus the separately named V11 companion, in one actual owner commit.
checkpoint_contract.immutable_policy: All original top-level values, ten entire gate objects and acceptance/closure requirements, nine non-CI intakes, the HOSTED-CI historical object, original provider/H unknowns and all eighteen prior closed entries remain in the unchanged original blob.
checkpoint_contract.limited_current_precedence: Only the companion's explicitly named current source/evidence publication identities and observation time are current labels. All earlier execution records retain their original source and time. No generic override or implicit result transfer is allowed.
checkpoint_contract.discovery: The actual PR description and review entry point must link both components and explicitly identify the unchanged baseline as V10 history. A consumer that reads only BLOCKERS.json does not automatically consume the companion.
checkpoint_contract.future_flattening: A future single-file ledger would require its own concretely reviewed and actually executed transformation against the then-current owner baseline; this companion is not evidence that the frozen Python generator ran.
